description: Fixture/case dataset only. No results, proof reports, conversations or run history.

archive.name: agentests-v1-fixtures.zip
archive.format: ZIP_STORED; sorted regular files, fixed 1980-01-01 timestamp, Unix 0644/0755 modes; no compression-library dependency

inventory_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON list, sorted by path; records contain path, mode (decimal), bytes, sha256; json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon))
